title: Daemon command registry extraction
description: Objective: create room for the effect.activate ingress without growing the 397-line daemon-store-dependencies.ts past the split-before-400 rail. NOT in scope: registering effect.activate, changing authorization/payload policy, recovery reads, store schema, or activation behavior.
